mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for post-remodel finish painting in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for post-remodel finish painting in the East Bay, look for experience specifically with new construction or renovation projects, not just general repaints. Verify their licensing and insurance, and request references or a portfolio showcasing similar work. A reputable contractor, like Frasheski Construction, will provide a detailed proposal, clearly outline the scope of work, and use quality materials, ensuring a smooth process and high-quality finish suited to the area's diverse property types.
